sources.title: Hugging Face Hub platform root
sources.notes: Platform root for repository URL construction only. Reachability verified HTTP 200, no redirect. Type 'other': the platform root is neither a repo nor docs.

sources.title: Hugging Face Hub — HfApi Client documentation (huggingface_hub 2.1.1)
sources.notes: Authoritative reference for model_info/list_models semantics, token=False anonymous access, and timeout support. Reachability verified HTTP 200, no redirect.

sources.title: Hugging Face Hub — Model Cards documentation
sources.notes: Defines model-card metadata fields (license, base_model, pipeline_tag, datasets, eval results). Publisher claims stay publisher claims. Verified HTTP 200, no redirect.

sources.title: Hugging Face Hub — Repository Cards / ModelCardData documentation
sources.notes: Reference for ModelCard/ModelCardData structures used to read card metadata without executing repository code. Verified HTTP 200, no redirect.

sources.title: Hugging Face Hub — Security documentation
sources.notes: Security features reference (tokens, malware scanning, pickle scanning). Atlas never executes scanned files; scanning presence never authorizes execution. Verified HTTP 200.

sources.title: Hugging Face Hub — Pickle Scanning documentation
sources.notes: Documents pickle import scanning. Atlas policy: never torch.load / pickle.load remote artifacts regardless of scan results. Verified HTTP 200.

sources.title: Open Source Initiative — Open Source AI Definition 1.0
sources.notes: Baseline standard cited by open_source_ai_reference. Permissive weight licenses alone never imply this classification. Verified HTTP 200 (also in Phase 0).

sources.title: SPDX License List
sources.notes: Authority for SPDX identifier claims. Non-listed values stay custom license ids, never force-mapped. Verified HTTP 200 (also in Phase 0).

sources.title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 — Core specification
sources.notes: Normative dialect for all Atlas schemas. Phase 1 makes no schema changes, so this entry records the unchanged baseline. Verified HTTP 200.

sources.title: ggml-org/llama.cpp — official repository (GGUF and quantization implementation)
sources.notes: Phase 2: authoritative reference for GGUF container and ggml quantization type definitions (K-quants, IQ-quants, TQ family, F16/BF16, MXFP4 paths). Registry source_revision recorded per entry.

sources.title: Hugging Face Hub — GGUF documentation
sources.notes: Phase 2: GGUF metadata and tensor information exposure. Structured metadata preferred before any raw parsing.

sources.title: Hugging Face Transformers — Quantization overview (AWQ/GPTQ/bitsandbytes)
sources.notes: Phase 2: distinguishes AWQ and GPTQ as independent algorithm families with quantization_config (bits, group size, backend).

sources.title: turboderp/exllamav2 — official EXL2 project
sources.notes: Phase 2: EXL2 mixed-quantization family bound to the ExLlamaV2 runtime; never equated to Q4_K_M or AWQ-4bit.

sources.title: ml-explore/mlx-lm — official MLX-LM project
sources.notes: Phase 2: MLX quantization methods (affine, dynamic, AWQ, GPTQ, MXFP4/NVFP4 modes per version) and KV-cache quantization options.

sources.title: NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM official repository (quantization recipes and hardware support matrices)
sources.notes: Authoritative project for TensorRT-LLM quantization recipes (incl. NVFP4/MXFP4) and model/hardware support matrices, which drift with releases. Recorded by access date. Verified HTTP 200.
